title: sorbus variolosa
intro: Sorbus variolosa, commonly known as the Chinese Rowan or Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as coughs and colds, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Sorbus variolosa can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate fever, and modulate the immune system, making it a valuable natural remedy in traditional Chinese medicine.
